title: Pocketwire Advance Due-Date Extensions — Standard and Hardship
content:
Pocketwire Advance offers two kinds of due-date extension. Both kinds of extension are the customer's own request and change only the due date, never the amount owed.

## Standard extension

A standard extension is available only on tiers on which the standard extension is available, when the line has at least the tier's number of consecutive on-time repayments, within the tier's standard extensions per advance on that advance and the tier's standard extensions per calendar year on the line. The standard extensions of a year are those dated in the calendar year containing the handling date. A standard extension moves the due date the tier's extension days in calendar days later and books an extension fee, at 0.00 on tiers without a fee.

## Hardship extension

A hardship extension is granted when the verified customer states a loss of income or an emergency expense, once per the tier's hardship extensions per calendar year, on any tier and whatever the on-time history, moving the due date the tier's hardship extension days in calendar days later with no fee. The customer's statement is the authority for the hardship.

## Timing for both kinds

An extension is granted only before the advance is late: the extension is recorded no later than the advance's current due date, that is, 0 days after it. The due date is compared as a calendar date, and an extension on the due date itself qualifies.

| Extension recorded on | Against a current due date of the 20th |
|---|---|
| The 19th | Qualifies |
| The 20th | Qualifies — the due date itself |
| The 21st | Does not qualify |

## Standard extension conditions

Every one of these must hold for a standard extension; if any one does not, a standard extension is not available:

- the tier offers the standard extension;
- the line's consecutive on-time repayments reach the tier's number;
- the advance has not used up the tier's standard extensions per advance;
- the line has not used up the tier's standard extensions per calendar year;
- the extension is recorded no later than the current due date.

## Worked extension (hypothetical)

An advance on Pocketwire Advance Standard (extension of 14 calendar days, fee 0.00) is due on 20 May. A standard extension recorded on 20 May moves the due date to 3 June and books an extension fee entry of 0.00. A hardship extension on the same tier would add 14 calendar days with no fee.
